candidate_rule.label: sublinear long-term breeding-space contraction / spatial inertia
candidate_rule.form: E proportional to N^kappa along long-term population trajectories

falsified_or_unsupported_rules.universal_quarter_power_constant: unsupported; the common estimate is near 0.25 but LOO values span 0.139-0.354 and population kappas span 0.069-0.465
falsified_or_unsupported_rules.universal_threshold_collapse: unsupported; single power law had lowest equal-weight whole-population LOO RMSE versus quadratic and 50/25/10% hinges
falsified_or_unsupported_rules.simple_predictor_of_kappa: unsupported; initial E, component count, initial evenness, and decline depth all had worse LOO RMSE than intercept-only

timescale.interpretation: candidate long-term state/trajectory relation rather than year-to-year response law

interpretation_boundary: Exploratory only; cannot modify the frozen Ecology Report.
Five population units are nested within two monitoring systems.
Kappa is a trajectory descriptor, not a causal demographic parameter.
Spatial inertia is a candidate interpretation to test in independent component-resolved colonies.
